title: Fear
spec: Get out of the ring round the light.

say: This is your swimmer, seen from above: the tip of its triangle is the way it heads. On its right, a light, with a dashed ring round it.
At the foot of the drawer, Objectives: what the level asks, each with its bar. Here, get out of the ring round the light in time.
Run plays the level; the Editor builds the swimmer. It has no eyes and no thrusters yet: click the Editor tab, or the Editor button at the bottom left, to build them.
The board is your swimmer's body, its front to the right: a part acts where it sits. Click a cell, and the Wheel, in Tools, shows what can go there.
The bar opens the drawers, one at a time, each by its initial too: Tools, Parts, Files, Diagnostic, Navigator. At its foot: Hints, Settings, Chapters, and Run.
Stuck? Hints, the life ring, or ?, gives three hints, one at a time; the last shows a swimmer that wins.
